_comment: Lecture-keyword aliases (app/core/concepts.py). Key = what a student might type (case and hyphens ignored); value = one or more phrases to match against topic, branch, subtopic and tag names. Spelling variants (-ise/-ize, -our/-or, plurals) are handled in code, not here.
